errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите модели, като моделите са подредени в реда CoT, CoD, CCoT и CoUT.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis represents the model categories. The chart does not have a horizontal axis with these labels. Instead, it is divided into two main groups ('Accuracy' and 'Token Count'), and within each group, the models are represented by differently colored bars as defined in the legend.

The description fails to mention the primary organizational structure of the chart, which consists of two distinct groups of bars. The first group is under the label 'Accuracy (%)', and the second is under 'Token Count'.

errors.text_span: Each model is represented by a single colored bar
errors.evidence: The chart shows two bars for each model, not one. There is one bar for 'Accuracy' and a second bar for 'Token Count' for each model, totaling eight bars.

errors.text_span: The red bar representing CoT extends to approximately 91.19% accuracy and has a token count of 676.85; the orange bar for CoD reaches approximately 80.89% accuracy with a token count of 534.24; the light blue bar for CCoT reaches 88.50% accuracy and has a token count of 445.91; and the green bar for CoUT reaches 88.40% accuracy with a token count of 354.46.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly implies that a single bar for each model represents both accuracy and token count. In the figure, these two metrics are shown using two separate bars for each model, located in two distinct sections of the chart.

errors.text_span: Above each model’s bar is a value representing the token count
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The values above the bars in the left section of the chart represent Accuracy (%), while the values above the bars in the right section represent Token Count.
The description completely omits the right vertical axis, which is labeled 'Token Count' and has a scale from 0 to 800.
The description fails to mention the legend at the bottom of the chart, which maps the bar colors to the model names.
The description incorrectly states the bars are not outlined, but they clearly have a black outline.

errors.text_span: and there are no annotations present
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims there are no annotations, but the exact numerical value is annotated above each bar.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Kategorien CoT, CoD, CCoT und CoUT, die in dieser Reihenfolge von links nach rechts angeordnet sind.
errors.evidence: The horizontal dimension does not represent a single categorical axis with these labels. The chart is organized into two main sections ('Accuracy' and 'Token Count'), and within each section, there are four bars corresponding to the categories defined by color in the legend.

errors.text_span: Die linke vertikale Achse ist mit "Accuracy (%)" beschriftet
errors.evidence: The left vertical axis is not labeled. "Accuracy (%)" is the title for the left-hand group of bars.

errors.text_span: Die rechte vertikale Achse ist mit "Token Count" beschriftet
errors.evidence: The right vertical axis is not labeled. "Token Count" is the title for the right-hand group of bars.

errors.text_span: Für die Kategorie CoT gibt es einen roten Balken mit einem Wert von 91,19 für die Genauigkeit und 676,85 für die Anzahl der Token.
errors.evidence: This phrasing incorrectly suggests that a single bar represents both values. The chart has two separate red bars for the CoT category: one in the 'Accuracy' section with a value of 91.19, and another in the 'Token Count' section with a value of 676.85. This error is repeated for all subsequent categories.
